title: GenSpan: Generation-Calibrated Motion Span Priors for Multi-Verb Video Corpus Moment Retrieval

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract Text-driven video moment retrieval (VMR) remains challenging due to limited capture of hidden temporal dynamics in untrimmed videos, leading to imprecise grounding in long sequences.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) is a practical but challenging video search task: given a natural-language query, a model must retrieve the correct video from a corpus and localize the matching temporal segment inside that video .

evidence.quote: # Introduction Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) is a practical but challenging video search task: given a natural-language query, a model must retrieve the correct video from a corpus and localize the matching temporal segment inside that video [8, 20, 24].

background_setup.summary: Unlike single-video moment retrieval, VCMR couples video-level ranking with moment-level boundary prediction, so a model can fail either by selecting the wrong video or by grounding the right video at the wrong time.

evidence.quote: Unlike single-video moment retrieval, VCMR couples video-level ranking with moment-level boundary prediction, so a model can fail either by selecting the wrong video or by grounding the right video at the wrong time.
